verdict.rationale: Stripe provides an official MCP server enabling AI agents to call the Stripe API directly (creating products, prices, payment links, etc.), plus agent-specific tooling like GitHub 'agent skills', a CLI sandbox that provisions API keys with no registration for coding agents, and idempotent requests that make multi-step agentic sessions safe. Payment Links and Checkout docs confirm the underlying product/price/payment-link creation flow is API-driven and no-code capable.
